audit.summary: Archived assessment: Minor. The universal logarithmic phase exceeds the stated C1 assumptions; Corollary 2.5 general-data extension must explicitly retain thickness; Lemma 4.1 compares with an unsupported unit seed
limitations: Limitations: Reviewed arXiv:2207.05147v2, 2022-07-13, 34 pages; later publisher version was not byte-compared.
Limitations: No counterexample to Theorems 2.1-2.4 or Propositions 4.4/4.6 was obtained.
Limitations: P2 counterexample applies only if the two printed distances are treated as standalone sufficient conditions; full inherited (8.1) excludes it.
Limitations: Bouin-Henderson theorem statement and hypotheses on pp1-3 were read and viewed, within a pp1-5 bounded dependency check; its complete proof was not reconstructed.
Limitations: The one-dimensional Heaviside delay example is not claimed to refute the p17 bounded-support higher-dimensional formula.
Limitations: No separate computational supplement verified and no author code executed; absence of code is not a defect.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
